strenc: stop self-labeling encrypted artifacts in the binary

files.patch:
@@ -19,9 +19,9 @@
  *  The pass generates two "key provider" IR functions whose bodies contain
  *  the compile-time AES round-key material:
  *
- *    void __aes_key_a(uint8_t out[88])   ← memcpy from .strenc.kd global
+ *    void __aes_key_a(uint8_t out[88])   ← memcpy from an unnamed data global
  *    void __aes_key_b(uint8_t out[88])   ← 88 individual store immediates
- *                                              in .strenc.kt code section
+ *                                              (code half of the split key)
  *
  *  Both are declared extern here; their definitions are injected by the pass
  *  after linking this stub module into the target module.
@@ -37,8 +37,8 @@
  * ── Segments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  *
  *  __aes_decrypt and helpers → default .text / __TEXT,__text
- *  __aes_key_a               → generated by pass, memcpy from .strenc.kd
- *  __aes_key_b               → generated by pass, stores in .strenc.kt
+ *  __aes_key_a               → generated by pass, memcpy from an unnamed global
+ *  __aes_key_b               → generated by pass, in-code stores (no data global)
  *
  * ── Compile flags used by CMakeLists ──────────────────────────────────────
  *

@@ -41,10 +41,15 @@ def strenc_key_providers(obf_ir: str) -> Optional[str]:
 
 @register("strenc_keysplit_sections")
 def strenc_keysplit_sections(obf_ir: str) -> Optional[str]:
-    missing = [sec for sec in (".strenc.kd", ".strenc.kt")
-               if sec not in obf_ir]
+    # Keysplit no longer relies on labeled sections: the split is the data half
+    # (__aes_key_a memcpy from an unnamed global) plus the code half
+    # (__aes_key_b individual stores). Also assert the de-labeling invariant —
+    # no self-describing ".strenc" section/symbol names leak into the IR.
+    missing = [fn for fn in ("__aes_key_a", "__aes_key_b") if fn not in obf_ir]
     if missing:
-        return f"key-split section(s) missing from IR: {', '.join(missing)}"
+        return f"key-split provider(s) missing from IR: {', '.join(missing)}"
+    if ".strenc" in obf_ir:
+        return "de-label regression: '.strenc' section/symbol label leaked into IR"
     return None
